_draft: SEEDED 2026-08-13 from live Masters+ data on patch 68.250 (Bayesian-shrunk win rate, 30-game prior, min 200 picks) as a STARTING POINT to edit, not a verdict. Bands: S+ >=53.5, S >=52.0, A >=50.75, B >=49.5, C >=48.3, D >=47.2, F below. Pick rate was deliberately NOT scored — whether a niche 54% pick outranks a flexible 52% one is an editorial call. Two places that judgement matters most: SPROUT / NORI / BARLEY sit high on win rate but are picked under 0.5% of the time, so they may be map-specific picks rather than general S-tier; and GRIFF / CROW / MEG / MAX / PIERCE are top-10 by pick rate but only around even, which is either a popularity trap or evidence they do a job the win rate does not capture. Edit freely — once a brawler appears here the guide page stops labelling its tier Provisional.
